name: Ollamac
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow primary updater behavior: Sparkle feed metadata includes a compiled SUPublicEDKey, while the app starts SPUStandardUpdaterController at launch; the primary updater therefore has a pinned EdDSA trust root.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish all released artifact signing and deployment details of the current upstream release.
Framework-delegated verification behavior depends on the packaged updater and release configuration.
